result.auto_fail_reason: Agent told the customer to 'shut up' during an argument over broadband outage restoration timeframes.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to provide an empathy or acknowledgment statement after customer explained acute distress over cancelled NHS psychiatric patients and life-critical crisis lines.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Agent repeatedly deflected responsibility, stating civil engineering contractors handle excavations and customer service agents cannot operate backhoes or dig trenches.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: CRITICAL AUTO-FAIL: Agent shouted 'Will you just shut up and let me explain the restoration process!' at the customer.

grader.scenario: Agent loses temper with frustrated broadband customer during prolonged outage (Auto-fail: 'shut up')
grader.notes: The customer called to check on a multi-day major broadband fiber outage affecting her home medical practice. While the agent correctly verified the customer, personalized the call, and investigated the optical line terminal telemetry, the agent failed Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement by brushing aside her panic over remote NHS patient consultations, failed Took Ownership of the Problem by deflecting responsibility ('Civil engineering contractors handle fiber excavations; customer support cannot dig trenches'), and committed a critical Auto-Fail breach under Build Rapport and Observed Professionalism at minute 8 by shouting 'Will you just shut up and let me explain the restoration process!' at the customer.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [01:30] Customer explained she is an NHS clinical psychologist with 32 patients cancelled in severe distress and two suicidal crisis cases. Agent responded with cold technical jargon about civil fiber sever without acknowledging the clinical emergency.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [02:15] Agent accurately restated that the customer had been offline for four days due to the major fiber cut disabling broadband and patient VoIP lines.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [17:15] Agent accurately retained major incident reference INC-882014 and confirmed Harrogate exchange restoration schedule without redundant re-asking.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [03:40] Agent: 'Civil engineering contractors and water utility crews handle underground excavations; customer service agents do not operate backhoes or dig trenches and have zero control over municipal repair teams.'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [05:10] Agent: 'Will you just shut up and let me explain the restoration process! Continuous complaining does not make the glass fibers fuse any faster!' - Severe unprofessional misconduct and verbal abuse.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [18:05] Agent explicitly verified: 'Have I answered all of your questions and completely resolved your support query today, Valerie?' and customer confirmed technical questions were answered.
